description: This source file implements the APIs for retrieving device information in a TR-069 managed device, specifically for a device with the model 'Device_DeviceInfo'. It includes functions to get serial number, software version, manufacturer, model name, hardware version, and other device details. The code interacts with system files, IARM bus, and other internal mechanisms to fetch and report device parameters.
